\section*{Build-demo study guide}
\begin{examplebox}
\textbf{Example:} In a right triangle, the angle is $30^\circ$ and the
adjacent side is $8$. Find the opposite side $a$.
\step{Want the side opposite the angle, know the adjacent --- that is TOA:
$\tan A = \text{opp}/\text{adj}$.}
\step{$a = 8\tan 30^\circ = 4.6188\ldots$}
$a \approx \boxed{4.62}$
\end{examplebox}
\begin{tryitbox}
\textbf{Try it:} Solve $x^2 - 7x + 10 = 0$.\\
\rotatebox{180}{\footnotesize check: $\ans{x = 2 \text{ or } x = 5}$}
\end{tryitbox}
